notes.blurb: A tiled hall on a stone platform. White panels between dark posts, and a roof of two tiers with the eaves turned up at the corners.
notes.construction: white panels between dark posts at close intervals, the posts carried through to the eave, openings tall and framed
notes.ground: a stone platform two courses high with steps up to it on the entrance side
notes.roofs: irimoya, two tiers, eaves deep and upturned, shallow (1,2) below and steep (2,1) at the ridge
notes.signature: the bracket course carrying the eave out past the posts
